head: working-tree
subject: Multiple xdstp authorities on one control plane
change: runtime.Options.additional_authorities extends the accepted xdstp authority set beyond Options.authority. The controller stores the set, validates listener/route/cluster/EDS/SDS names against any configured authority plus the expected short resource type, and still accepts old-style names. Authorities served by different xDS servers still need separate controllers.

tests.unit: src/grpc/xds/resource_name.zig covers matching across several authorities. src/grpc/xds/runtime/authority_tests.zig accepts an auth-2 cluster through a controller configured with auth-1 plus auth-2, rejects an empty additional authority, and rejects an unlisted listener authority.

focused_gate.command: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='xDS runtime' -Dtest-filter='gRPC CDS' -Dtest-filter='gRPC LDS' -Dtest-filter='SDS' -Dtest-filter='LRS' -Dtest-filter='xdstp' -Dtest-filter='authority' --summary all

full_library.notes: Earlier full runs at load 15-35 failed only the load-sensitive control-plane TLS reload test; that test was then migrated to memory-backed temp files and passes deterministically. The final run passed.

notes: Routing several authorities from one controller over distinct ADS streams remains open.
